_comment: B74 — Kraken xStocks (tokenized equity) universe for passive OHLC capture. 38 symbols verified visible in Kraken Pro markets/tokenizedEquities (2026-04-30 screenshots). Kraken offers 128 total xStocks; this is a v1 starter list and should be expanded via PR as additional symbols are verified. Per Langston cc-inbox #867 Q3 + #869 Q3: static config with manual update is correct for v1 — dynamic probing adds startup latency and failure modes for a universe that changes monthly at most. To add symbols: edit this file, append to 'symbols', and submit PR. The bootstrap re-reads on startup; no migration needed. Symbol format is BASE/QUOTE matching what wss://ws-equities.kraken.com accepts (no x-suffix on the WS, despite Kraken Pro's display name showing 'GOOGLx/USD' etc.).
